summary: Mustang Bio filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq Staff letter dated October 13, 2026, granting a second 180-calendar-day grace period, until April 12, 2027, to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement after failing to cure by the initial October 12, 2026 deadline. The company told Nasdaq it intends to effect a reverse stock split if necessary; compliance requires a $1.00 closing bid for at least 10 consecutive business days. Failure would prompt delisting notice, appealable to the Hearings Panel without pausing suspension. Watch reverse-split timing and Nasdaq deference.
